[P2] Return to the design phase for this public API change

Removing `timeout` changes the public `AgentcoreSessionConfig` constructor. CONTRIBUTING rule 3 requires an agreed design note for public API changes, including experimental APIs. The description explains the unused setting and its removal, but omits the options considered and records no maintainer agreement to a design note. This leaves the breaking API decision without the required design review. Please return to the design phase under rule 8, step 6, and provide or explicitly link the agreed problem/cause/options/choice/removals note before proceeding.
